note: LB.10b identity fixture (legacy-only, no matrix cell). A type a header declares is the same type in every file that includes it, so its qname is its C++ name: the namespace path (shop::Cart), or the directory for the global namespace (src::Widget, LB.2's monorepo rule) - never the header file. A type a source file declares is visible only in that translation unit and keeps the file scope (src::Widget.cpp::Local). An out-of-line member definition of a class the same file declares binds to that class at parse time (Local::a); one whose class lives in another file is a METHOD at the header rule's qname (src::Widget::run, shop::Cart::total), which LB.10c joins to the class. Before LB.10a the include-guarded header was parsed as C and its class dropped, the namespaced class was include::shop::cart::shop::Cart, source-file types were src::Widget::Local, and every out-of-line definition was a FUNCTION named Q::m under the file MODULE; after LB.10a (this packet's HEAD) the same shapes sit under the file-named MODULE: CLASS src::Widget.h::Widget, CLASS include::shop::cart.hpp::shop::Cart, FUNCTION src::Widget.cpp::Local::a.
